blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Monday said it is now investigating the connection between businessman Jaime Tan Cruz and companies tied to Vice President Sara Duterte and her siblings. NBI director Melvin Matibag made the pronouncement after establishing the alleged links between Cruz and the businesses associated with Duterte and brothers Davao City Rep. Paolo “Pulong” Duterte and Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte.
